title: 16 x9 Grid
slide_intent: Give motion designers a repeatable spatial unit so elements can align across a widescreen frame.
strategic_value: Shared alignment can give Instacart video titles and signatures a consistent place even when the footage or copy changes.
demonstration: A 16-by-9 rectangle is divided into square cells. The note specifies 120 px cells on a 1920 by 1080 px screen.
practical_value: Derive cell size from the screen dimensions and use square units to lay out a widescreen composition.

content_islands.spec: Set the format, square-cell rule and pixel example in the left column.

content_islands.spec: Draw a thin border around the 16:9 field. Divide it with evenly spaced cyan lines in both directions.
